# Zelta Design

> Zelta Design is a full-service architecture firm in Nutley, New Jersey, specializing in restaurant and commercial projects. The firm has completed over 1,000 projects for +40 brands and is licensed in 25 states. It handles a project end to end: site survey, schematic design, construction documents, permitting and plan review, code and accessibility compliance, MEP coordination and construction administration.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Zelta Design
- Headquarters: 139 Chestnut Street, Nutley, NJ 07110
- Phone: 973-933-6636
- Email: hello@zeltadesign.com
- Principal Architect: Erik Liepins, RA (Owner)
- Licensed jurisdictions (25): Arkansas, Connecticut, Washington, D.C., Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, North Carolina, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Vermont, Wisconsin, West Virginia
- Completed projects: over 1,000
- Brands served: +40
- Projects published on this site: 137 (119 with photography)
- Sector focus: quick-service restaurants, fast casual, cafes, and commercial tenant fit-outs
